sections.text: Continued cleaning and clearing drill floor
Performed TBT for milling 10 3/4" casing hanger meanwhile performed drops inspection on TDS
P/u and m/u 12 1/4" CH milling BHA.
RIH w/ 12 1/4" CH milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 71 m to 138 m.
M/u TDS and filled pipe. Recorded parameters up/down weight 82/78 ton, 80 RPM 2-6 KNM, 2000 LPM 11 bar.
Tagged 10 3/4" CH with CH mill at 141,26 m w/ 4 ton. Marked pipe.

Milled 10 3/4" casing hanger from 141,26m to 141,55m, 1500-2000 LPM 12-15 bar, 80-100 RPM 9-12 KNM, wob 1-6 ton. Got good indications that casing parted from CH. Torque decreased to 2 to 6 KNM after milling 29cm, observed small gas peak of 1 and 1 ppm h2s in gas trap. Pulled up 1 m with flow and rotation, no restrictions. Stopped rotation and slided down through CH area, no restriction.
Continued sliding down and tagged top of 10 3/4" casing at 142,66 m. Dressed off 10 cm of top of casing, 2000 LPM 15 bar, 80-100 RPM 7-9 KNM, wob 3-8 ton.
Pulled up and placed taper mill above CH. Circulated 2 x b/u, 3000 LPM 20 bar.
Flowchecked well for 10 min, static. Meanwhile performed TBT for drops inspection.
Performed drops inspection on TDS, moonpool, derrick and drill floor. No findings.
Performed TBT for manual handling
POOH w/ 10 3/4" CH milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 142 m to 108 m.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor. L/o cutter BHA, which was previously left on drill floor due to wind restriction on crane.
Continued POOH w/ 10 3/4" milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 108 m to 70 m. Over-torqued connections due to vibrations during milling.
Continued POOH w/ 10 3/4" milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 70 m to surface.
Cleaned string magnet, 22kg swarf. L/d 10 3/4" milling BHA.
Performed TOFS. Cleaned and cleared walkways and escape routes on drill floor. Meanwhile function tested BSR.
P/u 10 3/4" spear BHA. Inspected and serviced grapple. Set spear in catch mode.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" spear on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 148 m. Pulled up and verified spear engaged in 10 3/4" casing, 88 ton on weight indicator.
POOH with 10 3/4" casing on 5 1/2" DP from 316 m to 205 m.
Flowchecked well for 10 min, static. Meanwhile performed TBT for releasing spear at surface.
POOH to 191 m and l/d 1 single 5 1/2" DP.
R/u handling equipment for 10 3/4" casing
POOH to 175m. Set slips on casing. Disengaged spear. R/b spear BHA.
B/o 10 3/4" casing pup and l/o same.
Changed to casing elevator dressed for 10 3/4".
POOH with 10 3/4" casing from 175 m surface. Average pulling speed 6,2 joints/hr. Used manual slips and dog collar. L/o cut casing joint.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor
R/d handling equipment for 10 3/4" casing. Changed to elevator for 5 1/2" DP handling.
Performed TBT for running 13 3/8" EZSV plug
P/u and m/u 13 3/8" EZSV RT and plug. Installed springs on tool.
RIH w/ 13 3/8" EZSV plug on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 303 m. Avg. Tripping speed 450 m/hr.
Recorded up/down weight, 77/73 ton. Established circulation and washed the setting area, 800lpm/ 4 bar. Installed the 13 3/8" EZSV plug at 303 m. Load tested the plug with 10 ton.
Pumped 10m3 wash pill and 10 m3 push pill followed by SW while rotating string 50 RPM. Circulated until clean SW in returns, 2500 LPM 16 bar.
Performed TBT for cement job
B/o double 5 1/2" DP. M/u pump-in sub to string. M/u TDS. Spaced out 3m above EZSV plug.
Installed cement hose. Leak tested cement line to 100 bar for 2 min.
Pumped 10m3 drill water with rig pumps, 2500 LPM 14 bar. Mixed and pumped 7,8 m3 1,93 SG cement slurry, 600 LPM 16 bar. Displaced cement with 2 m3 drill water, 600lpm 14 bar, using cement unit.
